patch_description: Start from the best-performing prior approach (multiple greedy candidate constructions with different sort orders, each followed by a refine() local search that moves models off the hottest GPU). Then wrap it in an iterated local search: repeatedly perturb the best placement (relocate a random model even if it worsens max KVPR), re-run refine(), and keep the result only if it improves the best score. Fixed RNG seed for determinism. This escapes local minima and should further reduce max KVPR at negligible runtime cost.
